reason: The orthorhombic metric, Z=8 conventional cell, and an ordered UPd3/TiNi3-type average framework are strongly supported, and the submitted full-occupancy model is physically plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however. The comparable-Rwp report is unavailable, while the reported 0.993 profile correlation is not a whole-pattern residual and masks systematic intensity discrepancies; an independent profile optimization of the submitted CIF still gives about 8.1% unweighted whole-pattern Rwp (RMSE about 0.308 versus about 0.102 baseline noise), with especially material high-angle residuals. The trajectory created Cmcm by orthorhombically straining an ideal P63/mmc prototype and retained inherited rational coordinates, but did not refine the symmetry-allowed Cmcm internal coordinates or comprehensively instantiate and compare materially distinct distorted/order realizations. Thus the data support the cell and average motif more strongly than the exact submitted symmetry and coordinates, and another scientifically focused solution/refinement attempt could plausibly improve the candidate set.
